title: Phase 5.5.0.1 Historical Data Coverage and Funding Audit

calendar_duration_correction.corrected_calendar_span: Exactly 3 years and 3 days (1,100 calendar days)
calendar_duration_correction.explanation: The 4 Parquet files correspond to calendar partition directory years: 2023 (2 months), 2024 (12 months), 2025 (12 months), and 2026 (10 months). Total duration is 3.01 years, not 4.0 years.

cash_flow_conventions.long_sign: Long pays when rate > 0; Long receives when rate < 0
cash_flow_conventions.short_sign: Short receives when rate > 0; Short pays when rate < 0
cash_flow_conventions.notional_basis: Notional value at exact settlement timestamp
cash_flow_conventions.holding_overlap_probability: 12.5% of trades cross a funding timestamp (max 60m horizon / 480m interval)

funding_rate_audit.governance_rule: Absence of empirical funding data must NEVER be replaced with zero funding. Parametric funding scenarios must be classified as UNVERIFIED_ASSUMPTION.
